summary: All 41 original captures reviewed: 26 unique images individually inspected via lossless PNG conversion and 15 identical copies matched by SHA-256. Four immediate resize frames show transient older-layout pixels. All 12 later passive frames show the complete small-window layout; each series remains byte-identical after its first settled sample. General settings and Readiness are visible. Results, setup and updater dialogs are readable. This is not a zero-flicker claim.
limits: Observed Windows Server 2022 at 96 DPI only. Representative-PC, high-DPI, multiple-monitor and physical-trackpad acceptance remain separate.

Immediate samples occurred about 34-55 ms after resize observation; first settled samples about 301-334 ms; final samples about 1368-1400 ms. Filename timing labels are nominal. No exact universal repaint deadline is inferred.
The four immediate transition frames are retained, so this review does not claim zero flicker or prove what occurred between samples.
Requested 1280x900 was bounded to 1024x728. Actual reviewed workspace sizes are 960x680 and 1024x728.
25 PrintWindow captures request paint and are not equivalent to visible-screen pixels. Sixteen passive screen frames precede PrintWindow for their series.

The earlier full-frame interpretation that General settings and Readiness were missing from original run 37988570028 was a review error. Exact original-image crops show both controls; corrected receipts retain the retraction. This recheck adds passive resize evidence rather than fixing an established application omission.
